description: The Temperate Optimal Power Flow package dispatches generation while penalising heavily loaded transmission lines. Its quadratic line-cost formulation combines loading rates and thermal limits, with optional linear production costs and constraints on generator output over a period. The own README documents importing Matpower or PowerModels networks, setting up load and cost matrices, running an optimizer and retrieving generation or flow series. Geographic and temporal coverage follow user inputs. The HES-SO research package is freely available as Julia source and through the Julia package manager under MIT. It works with model-powermodels-jl or model-matpower network formats and supports dispatch scenarios for network simulations. A caveat is that an optimizer must be supplied separately; examples name open Ipopt and commercial Gurobi. Large time-series problems may need partitioning and substantial memory. The algorithm's loading penalty is a modelling choice, not evidence of actual operator dispatch. No optimisation was run.
